test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and fourth term is related to third term.

T3G : V16L :: R29A : T42F :: M43P : ?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4e035dc231f5754397ed5108b5c58576f5ffd934b24bb1a27d62b770a6db174.png] 

**Logic: **(2) and (5) are added to the positional values of the first and third letter respectively and (13) is added to the mid number.

T3G : V16L →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5559cd580a752b15ad8acb2fcc7a5e0e2716091cd0d9c7e8d3b7a4706595ab19.png] 

R29A : T42F →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53a3811f483a74a5c980388478b3314e4a089026e039f9a787b3320375e35605.png] 

Similarly, for 'M43P : ?' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/694dce752a1700395822d7f21d7d274901934367f5b4902b2a767efe37286528.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**O56U**".
